title: A cap for my mug
description: Four views of a mug with its lid missing. Start with the fit and the measurements.
prompt: I lost the lid for this mug and want to make a replacement cap. Here are four photos of the mug, rim, and inner grooves. I have a caliper with me. Look at the photos and ask me for the key dimensions and how the cap should fit. Please give me a short measurement form linked to these photos, with hints for where to measure. I have not supplied any dimensions yet.
